state_config_pct_range.name: state_config_pct_range
state_config_pct_range.value:
"state_config"."welfare_pct" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "state_config"."platform_fee_pct" BETWEEN 0 AND 100
          AND "state_config"."gst_pct_on_platform_fee" BETWEEN 0 AND 100

federations_level_state.name: federations_level_state
federations_level_state.value:
("federations"."level" = 'national' AND "federations"."state_code" IS NULL)
          OR ("federations"."level" = 'state' AND "federations"."state_code" IS NOT NULL)

booking_events_has_actor.name: booking_events_has_actor
booking_events_has_actor.value: "booking_events"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "booking_events"."actor_system" IS NOT NULL
